Ben — we can do this but with a couple of operational notes. Proposed approach:

1) Provision a guest "SecureViewer" account for Linda with the following controls:
   - Disable download/print/export at the portal layer (supported by our viewer).
   - Apply dynamic watermark ("Linda Nguyen — AuditOps — view only — {{timestamp}}").
   - Session logging enabled; export of logs to Finco upon request.

2) If auditor still needs a document (evidence that cannot be viewed in-page), we can provide a redacted excerpt PDF (SOC2-excerpt-redacted.pdf) watermarked and delivered via one-time link.

3) Link expiry: we can set the guest link for the engagement window and add a 72-hour grace extension that operations can enable without an SSO reissue. If you want IP restriction, we can add their auditor IP CIDR to the allowlist; please have them confirm the public IPs.

4) Bridge letter: Not strictly required for portal access, but clients often request one to confirm audit period dates and the short extension. If Finco requests it, I can draft a short statement (signed by Trust) confirming the report period and extension window.

Operational impact: minimal, but note this viewer relies on client-side watermarks and portal-level controls — not DRM. If Finco's legal requires irrevocable non-downloadable proof, we should escalate.

I'll schedule the guest account today after Ben confirms.

- Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
